Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added Sync: tempo-match and beat-align one deck to the other with one click
Songs get their BPM detected automatically, with a manual override if it's wrong
Added a manual tempo fader under each deck, with right-click to reset to normal
